Resolutions of the Lord Mayor

Approval of an immediate, unbudgeted expenditure for contractors’ snow-clearing wages. (5 Jan 1938) The saved Catholic auxiliary-school teacher position (Ms Wacholz) is to be converted into a Catholic teacher position as of 1 Jan 1938. (13 Jan 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 20 Nov 1937, entry no. 1674 in the register of deeds, with Rechtsanwalt Fritz Stähler, insolvency administrator for the assets of garden-owner Gottlieb Wilshaus, concerning an exchange of property. (19 Jan 1938) Budget estimate for the tramway for 1938/39. (22 Jan 1938) Budget estimate for the gasworks for 1938/39. (22 Jan 1938) Budget estimate for the waterworks for 1938/39. (22 Jan 1938) Budget estimate for the electric utility for 1938/39. (22 Jan 1938) The local bylaw on cleaning public streets and squares is extended until 31 Mar 1939. (28 Jan 1938) The local bylaw on refuse collection is extended until 31 Mar 1939. (28 Jan 1938) The local bylaw on sewerage is extended until 31 Mar 1939. (28 Jan 1938) Notarized contract of 20 Sep 1937, entry no. 1666 in the register of deeds, with Richard Loeb Caldenhof, graduate agriculturalist, concerning the sale of Gut Haus Mark to the City of Hamm. (1 Feb 1938) Wilhelm Thiele is elected to the vacant teacher position (formerly Karger). (2 Feb 1938) The municipal upper secondary school for boys is to be named Freiherr vom Stein School. The boys’ secondary school is to be named Graf Adolf von der Mark School. (4 Feb 1938) From 1 Apr 1938, compulsory vocational schooling is to be extended to daughters living at home and female domestic employees. (4 Feb 1938) The water-supply pipes in the Heessen-Hardinghauserknapp settlement are taken over from Bergmannssiedlung Hamm GmbH as of 1 Apr 1938. (5 Feb 1938) The female teacher position at the Catholic town school (formerly deputy headmistress Flesch) is to be converted into a teacher position as of 1 Apr 1938. (17 Feb 1938) Approval of an over-budget expenditure for Kurhaus Bad Hamm in 1937. (22 Feb 1938) Approval of an over-budget expenditure for physical education in 1937. (28 Feb 1938) Aloys Immenkötter is elected to the Catholic teacher position becoming vacant on 1 Apr 1938 (Rüther). (1 Mar 1938) The teacher position becoming vacant at the Protestant Südschule on 1 Apr 1938 upon deputy headmaster Osenberg’s retirement is transferred to the Protestant Westschule. (1 Mar 1938) No payroll tax is to be levied for March 1938. (10 Mar 1938) Fees are set for street cleaning, municipal drainage, and refuse collection in 1938. (11 Mar 1938) The building-line plan for Litzmannstraße and Am Lindenhof is adopted under § 1 of the Building Lines Act of 2 July 1875. (14 Mar 1938) The building-line plan for Luisenstraße is adopted under § 1 of the Building Lines Act of 2 July 1875. (14 Mar 1938) The building-line plan of 25 Feb 1938 for the area between Südfriedhof and Pilsholzstraße is adopted under § 1 of the Building Lines Act of 2 July 1875. (14 Mar 1938) The building-line plan for Caldenhofer Weg, sheets 2 and 3, the section between Heßlerstraße and the projected N.S. XII arterial road, is adopted under § 1 of the Building Lines Act of 2 July 1875. (14 Mar 1938) Approval of a visitor-tax schedule for the Warmquellensolbad, effective 1 Apr 1938. (15 Mar 1938) The visitor-tax schedule is restricted so that Jews may receive no concessions of any kind; foreigners are likewise not entitled to concessions. (10 Mar 1938) Jacob Cordes is elected to the Catholic teacher position becoming vacant at Catholic Westschule II on 1 Apr 1938 (formerly Schulte). (17 Mar 1938) Karl Klemt is elected to the Catholic teacher position vacated by teacher Schöpper’s transfer. (17 Mar 1938) Application to the school supervisory authority for approval to combine the four-class Catholic auxiliary school and the two-class Protestant auxiliary school under headmaster Mellmann, to improve teaching and educational provision. (18 Mar 1938) Approval of notarized contracts of 30 Dec 1937, register entries nos. 1677 and 1678, with Mrs Lauter, a Jewish woman and legal successor to Isidor Lauter, concerning cancellation of the contracts of 21 Oct 1925 (no. 857), 8 Oct 1927 (no. 1111), and the two supplemental contracts of 16 Nov 1931 (nos. 1407 and 1408). Properties are conveyed to Mrs Lauter. She conveys the commercial property on Bahnhofstraße, including the building, and pays the City of Hamm 100,000 Reichsmarks in cash compensation. These contracts are necessary because of the building-line regulations. (30 Mar 1938) Studienassessor Dr Erich Schlepper is elected to the vacant Studienrat position at the municipal upper secondary school for girls. (5 Apr 1938) From 1 Apr 1938, senior vocational teacher Paul Gollnick is to take up the newly created department-head position for unskilled workers. (6 Apr 1938) Effective 1 Apr 1938, the vacant technical teacher position at the municipal vocational schools (formerly Weiler) is converted into a department-head position for the unskilled-workers group. (6 Apr 1938) Effective 1 Apr 1938, the commercial senior-teacher positions are converted into senior vocational-school teacher positions at the municipal vocational schools. (11 Apr 1938) The following four building-line plans are formally confirmed under § 8 of the Building Lines Act of 2 July 1875: Litzmannstraße and Am Lindenhof, dated 24 Oct 1937 (C I c no. 81); Caldenhoferweg, between Heßlerstraße and projected arterial road N.S. XII, sheets 2 and 3, dated 18 Dec 1937 (C I c nos. 86–87); the area between Südfriedhof and Pilsholzstraße, dated 25 Feb 1938 (C I c no. 88); and the north side of Luisenstraße, dated 28 Feb 1938 (C I a no. 57). (5 May 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 23 Apr 1938, register entry no. 1684, with landowner Karl Brüggemann and co-heirs, concerning purchase of street land on Langestraße. (19 May 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 7 May 1938, register entry no. 1686, with Lilli Drewer née Nott, widow of Friedrich Drewer, concerning purchase of properties for conversion into green spaces. The purchase price is to be paid from sums due from Mrs Lauter, a Jewish woman. (24 May 1938) A second class is established at the higher commercial school from Easter 1938. (30 May 1938) From 1 Apr 1936, staff at municipal vocational schools are to be paid according to the Reich Salary Act. (1 Jun 1938) The 1938 budget for musical activities is increased for travel expenses and use of cars and trams. (10 Jun 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 2 Jun 1938, register entry no. 1688, with spouses Paul Scipio and Pauline née Kalf, concerning sale of property on Vorsterhauserweg. (10 Jun 1938) The building lines for projected Street no. 37 in the eastern district are rescinded under § 10 of the Building Lines Act of 2 July 1875. (20 Jun 1938) Approval of the boundary change between Hamm and the municipalities of Werries, Mark, and Berge agreed in the minutes of 15 Feb 1938 (see City of Hamm file no. 4036). (20 Jun 1938) The 1936/37 annual accounts of the gas, water, and electric utilities, tramway, and harbor are approved. (7 Jul 1938) Sale of the Wimbern waterworks. (7 Jul 1938) Bylaw on collecting school contributions for the municipal vocational school in Hamm. (7 Jul 1938) To ensure proper schooling for primary-school children in northern Hamm, the Protestant and Catholic North Schools are closed from 1 Oct 1938 and two new schools are established for northern Hamm. (12 Jul 1938) To urgently improve teaching and educational provision, the four-class Catholic and two-class Protestant auxiliary schools are to close on 1 Oct 1938 and a new six-class auxiliary school established on that date. (12 Jul 1938) The vacant vocational-school female trade teacher position is converted into a senior commercial teacher position as of 1 Oct 1938. (12 Jul 1938) Technical school applicant Grete Molitor is elected to the technical female teacher position at Catholic Westschule I (Mrs Hockelmann). (12 Jul 1938) School applicant Charlotte Kempa is elected to the vacant technical female teacher position at Catholic Südschule I (Mrs Fertmann). (12 Jul 1938) Approval of an immediate, unbudgeted payment to Wirtschaftsberatung Deutscher Gemeinden AG, Berlin, for its completed efficiency and organizational review of the municipal care home. (13 Jul 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 12 Jul 1938, register entry no. 1696, with Heinrich Kreiß, concerning sale of property on Vorsterhauserweg. (16 Jul 1938) Johann Kirse, merchant, of Ostenallee 155, is to transfer parcel 2861/153, cadastral district 11, to the municipality as street land. It is jointly mortgaged for a 1,750-Goldmark mortgage loan to the municipal poor-relief administration and a 6,000-Goldmark loan to the City of Hamm—United Cappel-Bacharach-Kamp and Lantz Foundation. Release of the parcel from the joint mortgage liability is approved. (18 Jul 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 28 Jun 1938, register entry no. 1694, with Vereinigte Stahlwerke AG and Westfälische Wohnstätten AG, concerning reciprocal conveyance of land parcels (Phoenix, Beukenberg, and Unionstraße). (18 Jul 1938) Effective 1 Jul 1938, senior commercial teacher Kortmann and senior commercial teachers Rienermann and Hesse are assigned senior vocational-school teacher positions at the municipal vocational schools. (22 Jul 1938) The municipal utilities pay a concession fee to the city. (8 Aug 1938) The harbor is combined with the other commercial undertakings (municipal utilities). (8 Aug 1938) The building lines for projected Street no. 37 in the eastern district are formally rescinded under §§ 8 and 10 of the Building Lines Act of 2 July 1875. (16 Aug 1938) A guarantee is to be assumed and the corresponding guarantee instrument issued for Aktiengesellschaft Ruhr-Lippe-Kleinbahnen, Soest, concerning an amortization loan from the board of the German Private Railways Pension Fund, a public-law corporation, in Berlin. (27 Aug 1938) Approval of funds to procure typewriters and calculating machines and immediately pay the invoices already received. (30 Aug 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 25 Jul 1938, register entry no. 1697, with Berta Harling née Rüter, wife of Bernhard Harling, Dortmund, concerning sale of the property and dwelling house on Geibelstraße. (15 Sep 1938) Auxiliary-school teacher Dietrich Hans is elected to the headmaster position at the Hamm auxiliary school, vacant from 1 Oct 1938. (15 Sep 1938) From repayments of municipal housing-interest-tax mortgage loans, such loans are granted to Emil Nofz, Heideweg 3a, for two flats on Julienweg; Paul Schroth, Herringerweg 121, to build a home on Kissingerweg; and HGB for a six-flat house on Droste-Hülshofstraße at the corner of Arndtstraße. (6 Oct 1938) The Protestant East School is to close on 1 Apr 1939; at the same time its classes established under the name German Community School are to become an independent school system, with both Protestant and Catholic teachers employed. Protestant children living in the former East School district are assigned to the Protestant Südschule, unless their parents wish them to attend the German Community School or Catholic town school. (21 Oct 1938) Senior teacher König is to become headmaster of North School II. (27 Oct 1938) Housing-interest-tax mortgage loans are granted from repayments: to Arbeiter-Spar- und Bauverein eGmbH in Hamm for 18 flats on Alsenstraße for members Matzke, Kuhlmann, Kocken, Westerwinter, Deittert, and Schmidt; and to HGB for 10 small homestead plots, 16 small flats on Königgrätzerstraße, and 20 small flats on Wörthstraße. (2 Nov 1938) School applicant Ferdinand Schäfer is elected to the vacant teacher position (formerly deputy headmistress Flesch). (3 Nov 1938) Youth leader Margarete Kockelke is to be appointed for life to an upper-school female teacher position at the municipal upper secondary school for girls, effective 3 Nov 1938. (11 Nov 1938) Senior vocational teacher Maria Gülker is to be appointed as a civil servant subject to revocation, effective 1 Oct 1938. (11 Nov 1938) Vocational teacher Maria Fisch is to be appointed an upper-school teacher subject to revocation, effective 1 Oct 1938. (15 Nov 1938) A mortgage loan from foundation funds is granted to August Vatheuer of Werlerstraße to build an extension to his house. (15 Nov 1938) Tram fares are changed effective 1 Jan 1939; the Ostenwall and Eylertstraße stops are combined to improve traffic flow on Oststraße. (24 Nov 1938) Approval to establish an open freight yard at the harbor. (28 Nov 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 6 Oct 1938, register entry no. 1701, with farmers Karl and Wilhelm Kohlhase of Waterloostraße, concerning sale of land between Lange-, Dortmunder-, Eupen-, and Waterloostraße. (2 Dec 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 14 Oct 1938, register entry no. 1702, with Albert Melcher of Langestraße, concerning sale of land parcels on Langestraße and an exchange of property. Because the synagogue’s cramped location and wooden roof structure pose a constant fire hazard to the surrounding old half-timbered houses, the synagogue is to be demolished at the congregation’s expense; the dwelling house is to remain in residential use. (12 Dec 1938) Approval of the notarized contract of 18 Oct 1938, register entry no. 1703, with merchant Friedrich Bröker, concerning sale of the property at Friedrichsplatz 12. (4 Apr 1944) Studienassessor August Ruwe is elected to the vacant Studienrat position (Dr Preusser) at the municipal upper secondary school for girls. (4 Apr 1944) Studienassessor Hermann Diekwisch is elected to a new Studienrat position at Freiherr vom Stein School. (4 Apr 1944) Approval of contract of 8 Apr 1944, entry 1799, with Ferdinand Wellié for sale of property at Kentroperweg/Irgahnstraße. (18 Apr 1944) Teachers Hennenberg of Hamm and Varney of Afferde are designated for the two new middle-school female teacher positions at the municipal girls’ school. (12 Aug 1944) Approval of the Ruhr-Lippe Railways AG’s application to carry out the land-ownership settlement, involving ownership changes for the city and the company. (16 Aug 1944) Approval of contracts of 15 Apr and 4 May 1944, register entry no. 1800, with Dr Kurt Brüggemann of Essen, Mrs Färber née Dohmwirth of Hamm, and Brökelmann, concerning a property exchange on Südring and Am Stadtbad.
